name: approve
description: Answers Claude Code's permission prompts through comando's approval cards. Claude Code calls it; do not call it yourself.

name: ui_show_table
description: Shows rows you hold as a table in comando. Use for results the user should scan, sort or copy.

title.description: Tab title; a later call with the same title replaces the table unless the user pinned it.

rows.description: One array per row, as many values as columns.

name: ui_plot
description: Plots numeric series over shared axes in comando. With time_x, x values are epoch milliseconds.

name: ui_show_view
description: Shows a view in comando. type markdown: data {markdown}. diff: data {path, before, after}. text: data {path, text, syntax, line}. tree: data {root: {label, detail, children: [...]}}. table and plot take the same data as ui_show_table and ui_plot.

name: ui_set_editor
description: Replaces the text of an editor panel. Without panel, uses the user's focused panel when it is bound to this session, else this session's first panel; a session bound to no panel must pass panel.

name: ui_insert
description: Inserts text in an editor panel at the caret, or appends it as a new paragraph.

name: ui_open_file
description: Opens a file read-only in comando's side pane, scrolled to a line. Relative paths resolve against the session's working directory.

name: ui_notify
description: Shows a message in comando's status bar and as a desktop notification.

name: ui_get_state
description: Returns comando's panels with their bindings and last SQL run, the connections, the sessions and the open views.

name: ui_set_layout
description: Arranges comando's window. Every argument is optional: panel focuses an editor panel by id or title; lower_tab selects results, session, approvals, terminal, or a view in the lower panel by id or title; sidebar and side_pane show (true) or hide (false) those panes; lower_share sets the lower panel's share of the window height, 0.05 to 0.95.

name: ui_close_view
description: Closes a view this session placed, by the id ui_get_state reports. Views the user opened or pinned cannot be closed.

name: db_run_sql
description: Runs one SQL statement on a database connection and returns rows as tab-separated text. Read-only statements run at once; others need the user's approval, and production connections refuse them. Without connection, uses the connection of this session's panel; a session bound to no panel must pass connection.

show.description: Also show the rows as a table view.

title.description: Title of the table view when show is true.

name: db_describe
description: Lists the columns of a table: name and type.
